verified: A window must cover the monitor bounds to count as fullscreen; a maximized window leaving the taskbar area visible does not qualify.
The clock hides only when it is topmost, fullscreen hiding is enabled, and another window covers its monitor.
Legacy clock preferences without this setting default to hiding the clock during fullscreen.
The real WPF acceptance enabled the clock, verified its settings and exercised local foreground window probing.
